chipSemantics.operatorWaveforms: Uses opl_registers revision1: one sine waveform. OPL2 waveform enable and E0 selections do not apply.
chipSemantics.muteLayout: Bits0..8 physicalFM/rhythm groups; bit9 ADPCM. FM and ADPCM continue clocking when muted.
chipSemantics.output: FM shift1 plus ADPCM output shift3 summed, then YM3014-style roundtrip_fp truncation. Mono output copied identically to both stereo arrays.
chipSemantics.sampleRate: floor(clock/72); wrapper advances timer interface by literal72 masterclocks per generated native frame. Minimum timerA4frames/288clocks; timerB16frames/1152clocks.
chipSemantics.readSemantics: Even offsets call live read_status (status synthesis into FM status can update IRQ). No fixed0x06. BitsPLAYING01,BRDY08,EOS10,TimerA40,TimerB20,IRQ80. Odd offsets dispatch selected register:05/19 externalIO returns0;09/1a call adpcm.read(0x02/0x13) and return0; all others including0f returnff. GenericADPCM read-reg8 memory/dummy side effects are not reachable through these existing Y8950 read_data mappings.
chipSemantics.sampleMemory: sample_interface vector is capped2MiB by load_memory range checks. RAM reads outsideallocatedsize and non-ADPCM access return0; external ADPCM writes only affect in-rangebytes. Explicit memorySize can grow withzero fill or shrink.
chipSemantics.resetMemorySemantics: Raw C reset resets FM/ADPCM and keeps external vector/pending address; publicreset recreates handle then uploads JS sampleMemory and reapplies mute. Native CPU datawrites do not mutate JS shadow, so publicreset restores shadow rather than retaining CPU-written bytes.

reports.authoredInput: Original synthetic OPL1 FM/rhythm programs and ADPCM bytes only. Nine FM voices, five drums, external/CPU ADPCM, up to2MiB memory boundaries and VGM type0x88 sample blocks are exercised without copyrighted ROMs.
reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: main complete body renders plus explicit257-frame post-scenario probes, including selected public reset/replays. Bounded wrapper positives and actual VgmPlayer Engine render-ahead/seek-prefix frames are separate components of totalGeneratedOutputStereoFrames. Engine internal native source frames and player delivered frames are not added twice.
limits: Native PCM runs at floor(clock/72), with each generated sample advancing interface clocks by72. Nine OPL1 FM/rhythm voices and one ADPCM-B voice are summed to mono and copied to both outputs. OPL2 waveform selection is ignored. Engine cases test separate averaging/holding rates without optional Sega PSG.

No raw save/load exports or public state API exist for this wrapper/Engine. Internal state bytes are not inspected or claimed equivalent; continuation PCM probes, public reset/replay and VgmPlayer seek replay are compared instead.

Raw reset preserves existing free-running counters and pending address; public reset recreates the native handle and reapplies the JS mute mask. Both existing paths are exercised without changing them.

Status supplies live ADPCM PLAYING0x01/BRDY0x08/EOS0x10, TimerA0x40/TimerB0x20 and IRQ0x80 without fixed0x06. Status reads synchronize live ADPCM flags into FM IRQ. Ordinary observations read status/even ports only; explicit bounded data-port reads are separate.

Y8950 exposes no generateStereoInto, snapshots or direct external-RAM readback. Existing09/1a data reads dispatch ADPCM indices0x02/0x13 and return0;0f returnsff. Explicit tests record actual behavior, without inventing dummy/data cursor semantics.

Public memory upload can grow or shrink storage; growth zero-fills and out-of-bounds external reads return0. Raw C uploads and CPU record writes change native RAM without updating JS sampleMemory. Raw reset retains that RAM; public reset recreates the handle and reloads the uploaded JS mirror. Clear empties storage without immediately resetting decoder history.

Y8950 readStatus synchronizes visible status into the FM engine: a masked timer flag can be cleared by reading while masked; timers continue and reassert. ADPCM EOS remains live until decoder reset and is maskable; current FM IRQ mask does not assert on EOS. Ordinary observations exclude data-port reads.

Public reset retains mute/gain controls. Replay tests explicitly reapply neutral controls before reset, then replay authored register/memory setup; separate positives verify retained mute and uploaded memory. Engine mute clears held resampling values until the next native sample while both sources continue.
VgmPlayer seeks use the existing replay-from-zero helper. Actual rendered Engine frames include prefetch queues and are counted separately from delivered/discarded player frames.
No browser, Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.

playerFrameDerivation.method: Twice full7168-sample baseline; each seek prefix plus257 continuation consumes authored waits through the next event boundary. Sum rates over3clocks×2builds; delivered seek-discarded frames are not added twice.

reviewedInvariants: Y8950 FM uses OPL1 single sine waveform,9two-operator channels and5rhythm instruments; OPL2 waveform-register changes leave PCM unchanged. FM feedback,connections,AM/PM,EGT and physical melody/rhythm mute progressions have positive controls.
Native rate is floor(clock/72), and the existing wrapper advances timers by72 masterclocks per generated frame. TimerA/B minima4/16frames; all9masked TimerA CSM voices sound with no ordinary key-on.

Live status has PLAYING01/BRDY08/EOS10 plus timer40/20 andIRQ80; no fixed06. Reading status synchronizes visible live status into FM. Unmask without a masked read exposes expired timer; a masked status read clears hidden timer flag until next expiry. These existing side effects are explicitly tested.

Odd reads are bounded explicit tests rather than ordinary observation:05/19 IO read0;09/1a dispatch ADPCM indices02/13 and read0;0f/ff readff. GenericADPCM CPU reg8 read/dummy/address cursor is not exposed by this existing Y8950 mapping, so no invented RAM-readback proof.

2MiB bounds,copy semantics,nonzero offsets,zero-fill growth,shrink/regrowth,clear,in-flight decoder history and out-of-range zero/discard behavior are compared to independently uploaded expected ADPCM PCM. Final64bytes at2MiB match low-address control.

Raw C upload and CPU data-port recording change actual external RAM without changing JS upload mirror. Raw reset retains actual patched/recorded RAM; public reset recreates handle and reuploads JS shadow. Triple-control PCM comparisons distinguish these paths.
Existing CPU record endpoint refuses the configured final byte; the independently uploaded31-byte expected patch proves that quirk. It is recorded without product modification.

Delta-N and nibble-order controls differ; memory mode granularity and level0 silence are tested.32byte/65535 one-shot reaches realEOS at65frames; repeat512frames traverses several wraps; stop clears PCM. EOS mask/unmask andIRQclear semantics are checked without claiming unsupported ADPCM IRQ.

CPU-driven feeds clearBRDY then8actual frames restore ready and audible PCM. ADPCM output is mono; register08 FM high bits do not pan it. Nine FM bits and tenthADPCM mute remain independent and preserve synthesis phases.

Engine whole mute keeps synthesis advancing but applyMute clears held resampler output. The exact1-frame prefix before next native sample is proven silent; following PCM equals continuously running reference. Engine masks persist across reset; replay setup deliberately neutralizes persistent controls.

Owned PCM is audible and both sides survive overwrite and actual capacity+1 growth. Engine averaging/holding source counts/remainder and single master gain are verified. No Into/snapshot API or serialized state equivalence is invented.

Actual VgmPlayer uses register command5c,clock header58 and sample block88. Nineclock/rate routes×6seeks replay from zero without checkpoints; final1536-byte sample mirror matches independently authored patched/offset data hash.

Main bodies/probes, bounded wrapper/memory checks and actual VgmPlayer Engine prefetch generation are separate. Delivered/discarded Player frames and internal resampling source frames are not added twice.

coverageReview.memoryAndReset: Expected bytes uploaded independently to comparison instances validate native patches/CPU recording through ADPCM PCM. Raw/CPU writes bypass the JS upload mirror; raw reset retains native RAM, public reset recreates/reuploads the mirror. These distinct behaviors are tested and documented without calling either serialized state recovery.
coverageReview.memoryBoundsAndDecoder: Zero growth, shrink/regrowth, clear, discarded out-of-range writes, the final64 bytes of2MiB and existing record-final-byte omission have meaningful reference outputs. Clear-tail test preserves an active nonzero decoder and distinguishes storage clearing from stopping.
coverageReview.adpcmControls: Delta-N and nibble changes affect PCM; level0 is silent; memory mode granularity matches current core; repeat remains audible past several endpoint passes, EOS arrives at65 frames in the bounded example and decoder stop clears output. CPU feed produces audible samples and BRDY transitions.
coverageReview.dataReadLimit: The preserved09/1A mapping calls ADPCM indices0x02/0x13, not CPU-data index8. Bounded reads assert actual0/FF behavior. Ordinary observations avoid data ports; no working external-RAM readback/dummy cursor or new API is claimed.
coverageReview.timerAndMuteSideEffects: Y8950 masked status reads can clear hidden FM timer flags; no-read unmask and later reassertion are checked separately. Nine CSM positives sound with TimerA IRQ masked. Engine unmute compares running source phase only after its calculated one-output-frame held-zero prefix; retained controls are explicitly neutralized before replay and tested separately.
coverageReview.FMOwnershipAndContinuation: Nine FM channels, two connections/eight feedback levels, AM/vibrato/sustain, sine-only behavior, five drums/mutes and bus latch are exercised. Both owned PCM sides survive overwrite and actual buffer-capacity increase. No Into/state API is invented.
coverageReview.playerSeekAndMemory: Real VgmPlayer type0x88 blocks cover authored patches/offsets/growth. Nine clock/rate configurations per build compare complete reset/replay plus54 seek windows from zero, with empty checkpoints. Final1536-byte JS upload mirror matches independently reconstructed authored bytes/hash; native RAM is not misrepresented as fully read back.
coverageReview.frameAccounting: Recomputed both-report body/probe/replay counts and independent bounded positive call sums agree. Wrapper memory frames are included once. Actual Player Engine output includes render-ahead/seek prefixes; delivered frames and native source resampling frames are not added again.
coverageReview.documentation: README, build guide, issue and SavePoint agree with eleven migrated artifacts and16 remaining, unchanged fixed379-file SDK and APIs/Mixer.59 Python and final126 Node tests are distinguished from initial pre-existing failure. FM Worklet4 routes, FM UI2, ADPCM PCM4/UI4 and Web/main-only exclusions are described separately; no remoteCI/publication/microphone/listening claim.
